mapper.sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.raw_status, '')) IN ('STARTING', 'STARTED', 'STOPPING') THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.raw_status, '')) = 'COMPLETED' THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.raw_status, '')) = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.raw_status, '')) IN ('STOPPED', 'ABANDONED') THEN 'STOPPED' ELSE 'PENDING' END

CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.task_stage, '')) IN ('EXTRACT', 'PARSE', 'RAW_DATA_EXTRACT', 'FILE_PARSE') THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.task_stage, '')) IN ('STANDARDIZE', 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE', 'TASK_STANDARDIZED') THEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.task_stage, '')) IN ('MATCH', 'STANDARD_LANDING', 'SUBJECT_RECOGNIZE', 'VERIFY_ARCHIVE', 'DATA_PROCESSING', 'TASK_PERSISTED', 'TASK_SUCCEEDED', 'QUEUE_COMPLETED') THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' ELSE 'FILE_PARSE' END

CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(, '')) IN ('RAW_DATA_EXTRACT', 'PARSE', 'TASK_RAW_PARSED', 'TASK_CREATED', 'TASK_DISPATCHED', 'TASK_EXECUTION_STARTED', 'TASK_REUSED', 'QUEUE_DISCOVERED', 'QUEUE_GENERATED', 'QUEUE_BACKFILLED', 'QUEUE_REUSED', 'QUEUE_UPDATED', 'QUEUE_RETRIED', 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBED', 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBE_ATTEMPTED', 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBE_CONFLICT', 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBE_SKIPPED', 'QUEUE_FILE_INFO_REPAIR_STARTED', 'QUEUE_FILE_INFO_REPAIR_COMPLETED', 'QUEUE_FILE_INFO_REPAIR_FAILED') THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(, '')) IN ('TASK_STANDARDIZED', 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE') THEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(, '')) IN ('SUBJECT_RECOGNIZE', 'VERIFY_ARCHIVE', 'DATA_PROCESSING', 'TASK_PERSISTED', 'TASK_SUCCEEDED', 'QUEUE_COMPLETED', 'STANDARD_LANDING') THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' ELSE 'FILE_PARSE' END

choose.when: CASE WHEN eb.file_id IS NOT NULL THEN || TO_CHAR(eb.file_id) WHEN eb.business_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(eb.business_key) IS NOT NULL THEN || REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(eb.business_key), , ) WHEN eb.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN || TO_CHAR(eb.task_id) ELSE || TO_CHAR(eb.JOB_EXECUTION_ID) END

CASE WHEN eb.file_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'FILE-' || CAST(eb.file_id AS VARCHAR) WHEN eb.business_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(eb.business_key) != '' THEN 'BIZ-' || REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(eb.business_key), '[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', '_') WHEN eb.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'TASK-' || CAST(eb.task_id AS VARCHAR) ELSE 'EXEC-' || CAST(eb.JOB_EXECUTION_ID AS VARCHAR) END
choose.otherwise: CASE WHEN eb.file_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('FILE-', eb.file_id) WHEN eb.business_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(eb.business_key) != '' THEN CONCAT('BIZ-', REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(eb.business_key), '[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', '_')) WHEN eb.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('TASK-', eb.task_id) ELSE CONCAT('EXEC-', eb.JOB_EXECUTION_ID) END

choose.when: CASE WHEN eb.file_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(eb.file_id) END
CASE WHEN eb.file_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(eb.file_id AS VARCHAR) END
choose.otherwise: CASE WHEN eb.file_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(eb.file_id AS CHAR) END

choose.when: CASE WHEN eb.START_TIME IS NULL OR eb.END_TIME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE FLOOR( EXTRACT(DAY FROM (CAST(eb.END_TIME AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(eb.START_TIME AS TIMESTAMP))) * 86400000 + EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (CAST(eb.END_TIME AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(eb.START_TIME AS TIMESTAMP))) * 3600000 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (CAST(eb.END_TIME AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(eb.START_TIME AS TIMESTAMP))) * 60000 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM (CAST(eb.END_TIME AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(eb.START_TIME AS TIMESTAMP))) * 1000 ) END
CASE WHEN eb.START_TIME IS NULL OR eb.END_TIME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (eb.END_TIME - eb.START_TIME)) * 1000) END
choose.otherwise: CASE WHEN eb.START_TIME IS NULL OR eb.END_TIME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, eb.START_TIME, eb.END_TIME) DIV 1000 END

choose.when: OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

mapper.sql: lb.batch_id, lb.business_date, lb.product_code, lb.product_name, lb.manager_name, lb.file_id, lb.filesys_file_id, lb.original_file_name, lb.source_type, lb.task_id, lb.input_payload, lb.task_stage, lb.current_stage, lb.current_step, lb.status, lb.progress, lb.started_at, lb.ended_at, lb.duration_ms, lb.last_error_code, lb.last_error_message, lb.step_status, lb.transfer_error_message, lb.execution_id

AS batch_id, AS business_date, pmrt.product_code, pmrt.product_name, pmrt.manager_name,
AS source_type, AS task_stage, AS current_stage, AS current_step, AS status, eb.JOB_EXECUTION_ID AS execution_id, COALESCE(ssh.has_file_parse, 0) AS has_file_parse, COALESCE(ssh.has_structure_standardize, 0) AS has_structure_standardize, COALESCE(ssh.has_standard_landing, 0) AS has_standard_landing, COALESCE(eb.START_TIME, eb.CREATE_TIME, eb.END_TIME) AS sort_time

FROM execution_base eb LEFT JOIN current_step cs ON cs.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = eb.JOB_EXECUTION_ID LEFT JOIN step_stage_history ssh ON ssh.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = eb.JOB_EXECUTION_ID LEFT JOIN t_transfer_object tto ON tto.transfer_id = LEFT JOIN product_match_rule_tag pmrt ON pmrt.transfer_id = tto.transfer_id AND pmrt.rn = 1

execution_base AS ( SELECT je.JOB_EXECUTION_ID, MAX(je.CREATE_TIME) AS CREATE_TIME, MAX(je.START_TIME) AS START_TIME, MAX(je.END_TIME) AS END_TIME, MAX() AS raw_status, MAX() AS EXIT_CODE, MAX() AS EXIT_MESSAGE, MAX() AS JOB_NAME, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'taskId' THEN jp.LONG_VAL END) AS task_id, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'fileId' THEN jp.LONG_VAL END) AS file_id, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'taskType' THEN END) AS task_type, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'taskStage' THEN END) AS task_stage, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'businessKey' THEN END) AS business_key, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'inputPayload' THEN END) AS input_payload FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION je INNER JOIN BATCH_JOB_INSTANCE ji ON ji.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = je.JOB_INSTANCE_ID LEFT JOIN BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION_PARAMS jp ON jp.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = je.JOB_EXECUTION_ID WHERE = 'valuationParseJob' GROUP BY je.JOB_EXECUTION_ID ), step_ranked AS ( SELECT se.JOB_EXECUTION_ID, se.STEP_EXECUTION_ID, AS STEP_NAME, AS step_status, AS stage_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY se.JOB_EXECUTION_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(, '')) IN ('STARTING', 'STARTED') THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(, '')) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE(se.START_TIME, se.END_TIME, se.LAST_UPDATED) DESC, se.STEP_EXECUTION_ID DESC ) AS rn FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION se ), step_stage_history AS ( SELECT se.JOB_EXECUTION_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'FILE_PARSE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_file_parse, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_structure_standardize, MAX(CASE WHEN = 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_standard_landing FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION se GROUP BY se.JOB_EXECUTION_ID ), current_step AS ( SELECT sr.JOB_EXECUTION_ID, sr.step_status, sr.stage_code FROM step_ranked sr WHERE sr.rn = 1 ), product_match_rule_tag AS ( SELECT ranked.transfer_id, ranked.product_code, ranked.product_name, ranked.manager_name, ranked.rn FROM ( SELECT ttag.transfer_id, pmr.pd_cd AS product_code, pmr.pd_nm AS product_name, pmr.org_nm AS manager_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ttag.transfer_id ORDER BY ttag.created_at DESC, ttag.id DESC ) AS rn FROM t_transfer_object_tag ttag LEFT JOIN tp_match_rules pmr ON TRIM(ttag.tag_value) = WHERE ttag.tag_code = 'PRODUCT_MATCH_RULE' AND ttag.tag_value IS NOT NULL AND ) ranked WHERE ranked.rn = 1 )

WITH , execution_enriched AS ( SELECT , AS file_id, NULL AS filesys_file_id,
AS original_file_name, eb.task_id, eb.input_payload, CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.raw_status, '')) = 'COMPLETED' THEN 100 WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.raw_status, '')) = 'FAILED' THEN 66 WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.raw_status, '')) IN ('STOPPED', 'ABANDONED') THEN 66 WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(eb.raw_status, '')) IN ('STARTING', 'STARTED', 'STOPPING') THEN 50 ELSE 0 END AS progress, AS started_at, AS ended_at, AS duration_ms, eb.EXIT_CODE AS last_error_code, cs.step_status, eb.EXIT_MESSAGE AS last_error_message,
AS transfer_error_message
), latest_batch AS ( SELECT ee.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ee.batch_id ORDER BY ee.sort_time DESC, ee.execution_id DESC ) AS rn FROM execution_enriched ee )

if.test: query != null and query.batchId != null and query.batchId != ''
query != null and query.taskDate != null and query.taskDate != ''
query != null and query.businessDate != null and query.businessDate != ''
query != null and query.managerName != null and query.managerName != ''
query != null and query.productKeyword != null and query.productKeyword != ''

sql.if: AND ( lb.product_code LIKE OR lb.product_name LIKE )

if.test: query != null and query.taskStage != null and query.taskStage != ''

sql.if: AND ( UPPER(lb.task_stage) = UPPER(#{query.taskStage}) OR UPPER(lb.current_stage) = UPPER(#{query.taskStage}) OR UPPER(lb.current_step) = UPPER(#{query.taskStage}) OR (UPPER(#{query.taskStage}) = 'FILE_PARSE' AND lb.has_file_parse = 1) OR (UPPER(#{query.taskStage}) = 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' AND lb.has_structure_standardize = 1) OR (UPPER(#{query.taskStage}) = 'STANDARD_LANDING' AND lb.has_standard_landing = 1) )

if.test: query != null and query.stage != null and query.stage != ''
query != null and query.step != null and query.step != ''
query != null and query.status != null and query.status != ''
query != null and query.sourceType != null and query.sourceType != ''

sql.if: AND lb.source_type IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(lb.source_type) = UPPER(#{query.sourceType})

if.test: query != null and query.errorType != null and query.errorType != ''

sql.if: AND ( (lb.exit_code IS NOT NULL AND lb.exit_code LIKE ) OR (lb.step_status IS NOT NULL AND lb.step_status LIKE ) OR (lb.exit_message IS NOT NULL AND lb.exit_message LIKE ) OR (lb.transfer_error_message IS NOT NULL AND lb.transfer_error_message LIKE ) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM latest_batch lb WHERE lb.rn = 1
AND UPPER(lb.status) IN
UPPER(#{status})

SELECT
FROM latest_batch lb WHERE lb.rn = 1
ORDER BY lb.sort_time DESC, lb.execution_id DESC

SELECT lb.current_stage AS stage, lb.current_step AS step, COUNT(1) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lb.status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lb.status IN ('FAILED', 'STOPPED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lb.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count FROM latest_batch lb WHERE lb.rn = 1
GROUP BY lb.current_stage, lb.current_step ORDER BY CASE lb.current_stage WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN 1 WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN 2 WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN 3 ELSE 99 END, lb.current_step

SELECT
FROM latest_batch lb WHERE lb.rn = 1 AND lb.batch_id = #{batchId}
SELECT lb.execution_id FROM latest_batch lb WHERE lb.rn = 1 AND lb.batch_id = #{batchId}
